_about: Written from the reasoning the two tracks recorded when they placed these bets on Sat Sep 19 2026. Every claim here is what the track cited at the time; nothing has been added after the fact. No homework section for these games — the run placed the bets but did not produce one.

tracks.intro: Two of Ahmed's rows are picked by Claude, each by a fixed method, and placed through the same form as everyone else. Research buys whatever the crowd most believes, at the best Kalshi price for that side. Statistics bets only where a price is wrong by more than the fee, and sits out otherwise — this weekend it sat out five of six games.

research.verdict: The most one-sided straight-up media consensus of the weekend, with the handle agreeing — though every ATS recommendation found went the other way.

evidence.text: Straight-up media consensus is 28–3 Dallas, about 90%: MMQB 7–1, ESPN 9–2, CBS 7–0, NFL.com 5–0.
Spread tickets are 65% Dallas carrying 84% of the money, and Yahoo reports sharps on Cowboys −3.5.
Models numberFire 68.6% and Dimers 61.1%, both Dallas.
Dallas is 8–2 against the spread in the last ten meetings and 15–5 against Washington over the past decade.
Roof expected closed, so weather is not a factor.
Recorded dissent: every published ATS recommendation found was on Washington, and Dallas is missing S Malik Hooker and LB DeMarvion Overshown with a rookie taking the green dot.
evidence.src: injury report and ATS roundup, Sep 19 2026

research.method: Bets whatever the crowd most believes will win, at the best Kalshi price for that side.

statistics.method: Bets only where the price is wrong by more than the fee.
statistics.pick: No bet — sat this one out
statistics.verdict: No edge after fees. Dallas is priced where the models and the books already agree it belongs.
